text: Naledi's dad passed away on Sunday. The funeral is next Thursday at 11am in Durban, and she flies out tomorrow night. Remind me to message her before she goes.
Lachlan got the keys to the new flat in Leith this morning. Moving van booked for Saturday at 8.

Coffee with Alessia this morning. She and Matteo have split up after six years. It was mutual, apparently, but she's the one who had to move out, so she's staying with her sister Fiona in Clapham for now. Says she's mostly okay, just exhausted. She's got a viewing for a studio on Saturday at 10 and wants a second opinion.

Karan was made redundant on Friday. Consultation meeting with HR is next Tuesday at 2pm. He's putting a brave face on it but his wife is worried sick. I should call him on Wednesday to see how it went.
Viewing for the two-bed on Albert Road is tomorrow at half 5. Bring the deposit paperwork.
Hana is moving to Osaka in a fortnight for her husband's job. Their kids start at the international school the week after.
Amara's gran died last week. She was very close to her, practically raised her. Funeral is on the 14th at 10am.
Don't forget to send Zara the number for the removals guy before the weekend.

Yuki says the landlord is selling up, so she has to be out by the end of next month. She's been looking in Bristol because her partner Leon works there, but everything decent goes within a day. She has two viewings on Friday, one at 12.30 and one at 5. Pretty stressed about it. I'll send her the link to that letting agent Jess used.
Bumped into Juan and his partner Wei at the station. They're relocating to Lisbon in March, both working remotely. Juan's already learning Portuguese.
Magda's dog Biscuit had to be put to sleep yesterday afternoon. She's devastated. I need to drop round a card this week.
Rafael's first day at the new place is Monday. He's moved down from Glasgow and is still living out of boxes.
Leon and Deepa broke off the engagement. The party on Saturday is off, obviously. He seemed relieved more than anything.

Long call with Hoang tonight. His mum has been moved into a care home in Reading, and he's driving down every weekend to see her. He's also just been told his role is at risk, with a decision due Friday at 4pm. On top of that, his brother Emil has moved back in with him after his own breakup. He sounded completely worn out. Must check in with him on Saturday morning, and maybe take him out for a pint next week.
Isabel loves wild swimming. Goes to the lido most mornings before work.
Aidan starts at Edinburgh Uni in September, studying architecture. His mum, Claire, is already dreading the empty house.
Sana mentioned her cousin's memorial is this Sunday at 3. She's doing one of the readings and is very nervous about it.
Need to cancel the gym membership before we move.

Chioma's new flat is in Peckham, top floor, no lift, which her dad found out the hard way carrying the washing machine up. It's lovely though, big windows and a little balcony. She finally feels settled after the year she's had. Housewarming next Saturday from 7pm, and she's dropped hints about wanting a big plant for the balcony.
Jess is vegan and allergic to tree nuts. Worth remembering for the leaving do.
Text Hadiza tomorrow morning to wish her luck for the tribunal hearing. It's at 10.
Alana's husband Ravi had his last day at the bank on Friday. Thirty-two years. They're having a retirement lunch at the Swan next Sunday at 1.

Ayesha said her uncle passed away in Lahore over the weekend. He was her dad's older brother and the one who taught her to cook. She's flying out tonight with her parents and won't be back until next Friday at the earliest. Her boss has been decent about it, thankfully. Don't forget to cover her Thursday shift and drop a note through her door.
Ximena got the flat! Signing the lease Thursday at 9.30 and moving in on the 1st.
Aiko works in conservation at the V&A. Restores old textiles, mostly kimono. Fascinating.
Picked up the boxes from Matteo's. He's keeping the sofa after all.
Fiona's brother Lachlan has finally moved out of the family home. Their mum is struggling with the quiet, Fiona says. Maybe ring her mum next week.
Emil Popescu, aka Popey, is leaving the firm at the end of the month. Leaving drinks are next Thursday from 6.
Karan's daughter Naledi graduated yesterday. First in Economics. He was absolutely beaming.
Hana mentioned she's really been missing proper ramen since the move. Could be a nice birthday idea, a ramen kit maybe.
Juan and Wei's house sale fell through again. Third buyer. The move to Lisbon is on hold until spring.
Remember to ask Zara how the second viewing went on Tuesday evening.
Grocery shop tomorrow after work, then meter readings on Saturday morning before the handover.
Alessia's mum is having her hip operation on Wednesday at 7am. Alessia is driving her in and staying the night. She sounded anxious on the phone. I should text her Wednesday afternoon.
Wei's sister Yuki is expecting in January. Wei is going to be an auntie for the first time and is thrilled.
Deepa has a second interview with the council on Monday at 11. She's quietly confident. If it goes well, she'd start after Christmas.
Isabel's cat Pickle went missing on Sunday night. Posters are up around Hackney. She's checking the shelters tomorrow morning.
Spent the afternoon packing. Kitchen is done, books next.

Dinner with Rafael and his girlfriend Ximena last night. They've been together a year this Friday and are going to Porto for a long weekend to celebrate, flying out Thursday evening and back Monday morning. Ximena wants to meet his grandparents while they're there, which he seems a bit nervous about. They also asked if I'd feed their rabbit, Dumpling, while they're away.
Mrs Santos next door is moving into sheltered housing in two weeks. Her son is coming over from Brazil to help. Must give her a hand with the garden pots before then.
Chat with Amara. Her sister Hadiza's divorce came through last month and she's moving back to Leeds with the kids. Amara is helping her look at schools. The house viewing is this Saturday at noon.
Leon is training for the Manchester half in April. Says his knee is holding up for now.
Funeral for Dr Chen is Friday at 2pm at St Mary's. Wake afterwards at the rugby club. A lot of former students are going.

Matteo has been offered a job in Milan, starting in a fortnight. He hasn't decided yet; it would mean leaving Alessia's brother Aidan, who he's been living with for years. Big decision. Ask him about it next time we're at football.
Aiko and her partner are moving to Brighton next weekend. They found a place five minutes from the beach. I'm helping them carry stuff on Saturday morning.
Ravi is coeliac. Mention it when booking the restaurant.
Claire said Uncle Hoang is having tests at the Royal Free on Monday. Nobody knows much yet. She'll let me know after.
Ayesha's back. The funeral was hard but she's glad she went. I need to take her for coffee this week and see how she's doing.

Jess's band is playing at the Lexington next Friday at 9. She's terrified because it's their first proper gig, and her parents are coming down from Sheffield for it. Her girlfriend Hana is organising a group to go along. I should buy tickets tonight before they sell out and text Jess good luck on the day.

Sana got the promotion to head of department, which she's been chasing for three years. Starts the new role after half term. The awkward bit is that Wei applied too and didn't get it, so things are a little frosty in the staffroom. Sana's husband is throwing her a small celebration at theirs on Saturday from 8.
Viewing at 4pm was a bust. Damp everywhere. Back to Rightmove tonight.
Fiona's partner Juan Barros is recovering from his appendix op. Home since Thursday, off work for another fortnight. Should send them something.
Message from Zara: her flatmate is moving out on the 30th and she's looking for someone to take the room. Thinks Lachlan might be interested.

Naledi seems to be doing better. She's back at work three days a week and her mum is staying with her for the rest of the month. Her brother Emil is also flying in from Joburg for the stone-setting next month. She says the hardest part is the evenings, so I want to call her one evening this week, maybe Thursday after 8.

Rafael's mum has been diagnosed with early dementia. His dad told him on the phone on Sunday, and he only found out because his sister Isabel let it slip. He's thinking of moving back to Porto to be closer, but Ximena's job is here and they've just renewed the lease. Very hard decision. He's flying over next Wednesday for her appointment with the consultant.
Deepa wants a decent pair of walking boots. Keeps mentioning it. Birthday is the 22nd.
Isabel's cat is home! Turned up in a neighbour's shed yesterday evening, hungry but fine.
Kitchen fitter is coming Tuesday between 8 and 10. Need to be in.
Magda starts her new job at the hospital on Monday at 7am. Early shifts all week. She's nervous after being out of work for a year, so remind me to text her good luck on Sunday night.

Lunch with Karan and Alana. Alana's dad's funeral was on Tuesday; she gave the eulogy. She's taking the rest of the week off and going up to Inverness with her kids for half term. Karan offered to water her plants while she's away.
